verdict.rationale: BVNK is a stablecoin and fiat payments infrastructure platform with a Portal and API. A built-in AI assistant is a plausible capability for this kind of SaaS product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows an in-product assistant that users can delegate tasks to: the llms.txt file and the agent-wallet-cli are developer/agent tooling, not a built-in assistant.
